name: lor-beauty
description: This project is a custom Ghost CMS theme for L'OR Beauty, a premium skincare brand

scripts.pwa:manifest:check: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p='./app.webmanifest'; const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8')); const required=['name','short_name','start_url','display','icons']; const missing=required.filter(k=>!(k in m)); if(missing.length){console.error('Missing manifest fields:', missing.join(', ')); process.exit(1);} if(!Array.isArray(m.icons)||!m.icons.length){console.error('Manifest icons missing'); process.exit(1);} console.log('Manifest looks valid:', p);"
scripts.pwa:sw:check: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p='./service-worker.mjs'; if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('Missing service-worker.mjs'); process.exit(1);} const s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'); const required=['self.addEventListener','install','activate','fetch']; const missing=required.filter(t=>!s.includes(t)); if(missing.length){console.error('SW missing expected hooks:', missing.join(', ')); process.exit(1);} console.log('SW structure looks valid:', p);"
scripts.pwa:check: npm run pwa:manifest:check && npm run pwa:sw:check
